import os, sys, copy
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

# CSV: header-only when empty, LF endings, standard quoting
assert export_rows([], "csv") == "id,name\n"
assert export_csv([]) == "id,name\n"
assert export_rows([{"id": 1, "name": 'a,"b"\nc'}], "csv") == 'id,name\n1,"a,""b""\nc"\n'

# normalization: only id/name, None/missing -> '', others stringified, order kept
rows = [{"name": None, "id": 2, "x": 1}, {"id": None}, {}, {"id": 0.5, "name": True}]
assert export_rows(rows, "json") == '[{"id":"2","name":""},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"0.5","name":"True"}]'

# JSON: ensure_ascii=False, compact separators
assert export_json([{"id": "é", "name": "日本"}]) == '[{"id":"é","name":"日本"}]'

# one-shot iterables and no input mutation
src = [{"id": 1, "name": "A", "extra": {"k": 1}}]
snap = copy.deepcopy(src)
assert export_rows(iter(src), "csv") == "id,name\n1,A\n"
assert src == snap
gen = ({"id": i, "name": "n"} for i in range(2))
assert export_rows(gen, "json") == '[{"id":"0","name":"n"},{"id":"1","name":"n"}]'

# unsupported formats raise ValueError and do not consume rows
for bad in ("xml", "CSV", "", None, ["csv"]):
    try:
        export_rows([], bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"no ValueError for {bad!r}")
consumed = []
def spy():
    consumed.append(1)
    yield {"id": 1}
try:
    export_rows(spy(), "xml")
except ValueError:
    pass
assert consumed == []

# dispatcher still works
assert export([{"id": 1, "name": "Alice"}], "csv") == "id,name\n1,Alice\n"
try:
    export([], "xml")
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("dispatcher accepted unsupported format")
print("exporter checks passed")
